subject.title: feat: advertise realtime voice provider voices in talk.catalog

question: Should `RealtimeVoiceProviderPlugin.voices` be a flat provider-wide compatibility set, or must the SDK represent model-specific voice availability before this public API lands?
rationale: Both Google and OpenAI voice validity can vary by model, so the field's permanent meaning cannot safely be inferred from the existing speech-provider precedent alone.

options.title: Define a safe flat set
options.body: Document `voices` as IDs valid across the provider's advertised model scope, populate Google accordingly, and defer model-specific metadata until a demonstrated need exists.

options.title: Add model-scoped voices
options.body: Replace the flat field with explicit model-to-voice metadata so clients cannot offer combinations rejected by a selected model.

options.title: Pause the SDK addition
options.body: Keep catalog model projection only and defer realtime voice metadata until the client migration and capability contract are designed together.

recommendation.title: Define a safe flat set
recommendation.body: Document `voices` as IDs valid across the provider's advertised model scope, populate Google accordingly, and defer model-specific metadata until a demonstrated need exists.

likelyOwner.reason: The relevant realtime provider and Plugin SDK ownership history is concentrated in their prior contract and Google voice work.
